verdict.rationale: Pipedrive clearly ships versioned APIs: separate v1 and v2 APIs with OpenAPI 3 specs for both, version-prefixed endpoints (/api/v1, /api/v2), and an official v2 migration guide recommending v2 where available. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods or a changelog of retirements, which is half of the story. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.
